item.text:
The retained TestBundle does not provide the domain contexts needed by this feature. The Background creates the customer, address, cart and carrier, so implementing only the scenario’s three steps would leave it undefined; replacing those setup steps with no-ops would also leave the rule check without the real cart and address it needs.

I haven’t added code because I can’t establish a reliable setup path from the visible repository. The key check needs the shipping-rule processor wired as `coreshop.shipping_rule.processor`, and the postcode condition is registered under `postcodes`. A complete context would also need to recreate the removed customer, cart, address and carrier setup.
